name: All the Mods 10 (W3LFARe Auto-Updating)
author: admin@eraflew.com
description: All the Mods 10 (ATM10) Modded Minecraft Server powered by W3LFARe/docker-allthemods10. Supports automatic updates on reboot or manual reinstall updates directly from the W3LFARe 6-hour auto-updated GitHub repository.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
apt update
apt install -y curl wget unzip

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

echo "Fetching latest launch.sh from W3LFARe/docker-allthemods10..."
curl -sSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/W3LFARe/docker-allthemods10/main/launch.sh -o launch.sh
sed -i 's|/data|/home/container|g' launch.sh
chmod +x launch.sh

cat << 'EOF' > pelican-start.sh
#!/bin/bash
cd /home/container
export EULA="true"

if [ "${AUTO_UPDATE}" == "1" ] || [ "${AUTO_UPDATE}" == "true" ]; then
    echo "[W3LFARe-Egg] AUTO_UPDATE is enabled! Checking W3LFARe/docker-allthemods10 for latest ATM10 release..."
    curl -sSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/W3LFARe/docker-allthemods10/main/launch.sh -o launch.sh.tmp
    if [ -s launch.sh.tmp ]; then
        mv launch.sh.tmp launch.sh
        sed -i 's|/data|/home/container|g' launch.sh
        chmod +x launch.sh
    else
        rm -f launch.sh.tmp
        echo "[W3LFARe-Egg] Warning: Could not reach GitHub, using existing launch.sh."
    fi
else
    echo "[W3LFARe-Egg] AUTO_UPDATE is disabled. Booting installed ATM10 version..."
fi

exec ./launch.sh
EOF

chmod +x pelican-start.sh
echo "eula=true" > eula.txt
echo "Installation complete! Start the server to download and launch All the Mods 10."

variables.name: Auto Update on Reboot
variables.description: When enabled (1/true), the server fetches the latest launch.sh from W3LFARe/docker-allthemods10 on every restart and upgrades ATM10 automatically if a new version was detected by the 6-hour GitHub Action.

variables.name: JVM Arguments
variables.description: Custom Java memory and garbage collection flags passed to JVM_OPTS in launch.sh.

variables.name: Server MOTD
variables.description: Message of the day displayed in the Minecraft server list.
variables.default_value: All the Mods 10 Server Powered by W3LFARe

variables.name: World Name (LEVEL)
variables.description: Name of the world save folder.

variables.name: Minecraft Operators (OPS)
variables.description: Comma-separated list of usernames to grant Operator permissions (e.g. OpPlayer1,OpPlayer2).
